versions.content: Available IO HW-Peripherals Type: valid Description: The ECU Resource template shall provide dedicated means to describe IO-HW-Peripherals. Rationale: The different IO-HW-Peripherals require dedicated means to describe their attributes from a hardware point of view. The different IO-HW-Peripherals require dedicated means to describe their connectivity in the micro controller and to the outside. 5 13 of 18  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 252: AUTOSAR_RS_ECUResourceTemplate Requirements on ECU Resource Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Use Case: • ADC channel 5 is available on pin 87 of the micro controller. • Variant Handling: If the micro controller is configured to have ADC channel 7 on pin 53, DIO can not use the pins 50-57 for its purposes. Dependencies: [RS_ECUR_00015] Supporting Material: 
